# mockingbird

> Local voice dictation for macOS on Apple Silicon: hold Fn, speak, let go, and clean text is typed where the cursor is. Free, open source (MIT), and fully on-device: Whisper for speech, a small local model through Ollama for cleanup.

To install or set it up for someone, follow the agent setup guide. It lists the steps, how to check each one, and the macOS permissions only the person can grant.

## Docs

- [Set up with a coding agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NirjharBhattacharjee/mockingbird/main/docs/AGENT_INSTALL.md): install, start, permissions and checks, written for agents
- [User guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NirjharBhattacharjee/mockingbird/main/docs/README.md): commands, permissions, troubleshooting
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NirjharBhattacharjee/mockingbird/main/README.md): what it is, install, everyday use

## Optional

- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NirjharBhattacharjee/mockingbird/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): how it works, for contributors
- [Privacy and security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NirjharBhattacharjee/mockingbird/main/docs/SECURITY_PRIVACY.md): what it can access, and what it never sends
